---
applyTo: "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}"
---

# Frontend (`src/`)

- React 18 function components + TypeScript; follow existing Tailwind utility patterns in `src/index.css` / components.
- Prefer updating existing Draft / Lore components over new top-level pages unless the task asks for it.
- UI copy: Chinese default with English toggle where the app already does so.
- Keep types in `src/types.ts` and constants in `src/constants.ts` when sharing across components.
- Do not introduce a new CSS framework or state library without an explicit request.
